JOIN OUR PYTHON DEVELOPMENT TEAM@LEVI9 IASI
 At Levi Nine we are passionate about what we do. We love our work and together in a team we are smarter and stronger. We work in a dynamic and challenging environment with talented and forward-thinking people who are part of creative and innovative teams. We are looking for skilled team players who make change happen. Are you one of these players? Join the magic number at levi9.ro.
 PROJECT DESCRIPTION:
 Our partner, ABN AMRO Clearing, is a global leader in the domain of clearing, offering access to a wide range of listed instruments on markets across the globe.
IT is at the heart of their organization with more than 30 different product teams and 10 different platform teams that are trying to build the best products & services for their customers.
Their presence in important financial centers like Amsterdam, Chicago, Sydney, Singapore, Tokyo Hong Kong, London, Sao Paulo, Frankfurt and Iasi, allows them to effectively serve clients worldwide and maintain close proximity to their diverse customer base.
 THE ROLE INVOLVES:
 We are looking for a Senior Python Engineer with a sharp eye for detail and deep technical expertise to play a key role in building and evolving our partner's solutions within their Client Instructing Team.
This role has a strong focus on serverless and container-based architecture and will involve working closely with other engineers to design, build, and operate reliable, secure, cloud-native systems.
 Responsibilities:
Design, develop, and maintain backend services using Python, setting a high bar for code quality and craftsmanship.
Build and operate solutions on AWS, with a strong focus on serverless services (e.g. Lambda, DynamoDB, SNS, SQS, API Gateway, Step Functions, etc.).
Implement and manage infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (AWS CDK and/or CloudFormation is preferred but not mandatory).
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable, secure, and well-architected solutions.
Ensure reliability, quality, performance, and security of applications, with meticulous attention to detail.
Actively participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and architectural decisions.
Troubleshoot issues in development and production environments and contribute to continuous improvement.
 TECHNICAL PLAYGROUND:
6+ years of software development experience with Python
Proven experience with working on AWS using IaC (CDK/ CloudFormation preferred but not mandatory)
Proven experience with SQL and Database technologies
Proven experience with container-based architectures (Docker, ECS, Fargate, or EKS)
Experience with source control tools like Git
Familiarity with DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines
 NICE TO HAVE:
Previous Tech Lead experience (formal or informal)
Good knowledge of event-driven or streaming platforms, such as Kafka
Knowledge of containerization technologies like Docker/ Kubernetes
Awareness of critical concepts in DevOps and Agile principles
Understanding of financial services and risk management in general
University degree in Computer Science/Engineering
 SOFT SKILLS:
Fluent English, with strong written and verbal communication skills
Strong engineering mindset and solid understanding of computer science fundamentals
Exceptional attention to detail: thorough in code reviews, design documents, and production operations
Good interpersonal and communication skills; comfortable working in a team environment
Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities
Ability to take ownership, deliver results, and work independently when needed
Willingness to continuously learn and grow in a fast-moving technical environment
